cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

mechanism: Copy a pianist's standing as performance readiness, then treat an abandoned accompaniment as making a future singing triumph more remarkable.
confusable: Not cheerful denial alone: the confident copied gesture must be misunderstood, and the reduced performance resources must enlarge A's promised win.
comparison: Audition singer and accompanist negotiating an unaccompanied attempt, rather than a team captain losing status.
seedUse: Uses collapsed-cake/resource-loss comeback seed as structural context, not props; no bakery facts claimed as direct inheritance.
